# Parent Scored

## W1

Strong banding effects seen

![](images/unnamed-chunk-6-1-02.png)

ANOVA shows:

-   Significant difference in p1sp, p1wtd, p1smc, p1thpr, p1pix, p1pmsx by p1edu1

-   Significant difference in p1sp, p1wtd, p1rbb,p1atnpr, p1pix, p1pmsx by p1edu2

-   Significant between group differences in p1anxdb, and p1smc , p1pix, and p1ppx by p1emp1

-   Significant between group differences in p1sp, p1wtd, p1rbb, p1atnpr, p1pix, p1pmsx by p1edu2

-   Effect sizes (\$\\eta\^2\$) are moderate-to-low (\$\<0.10\$)

## W3

-   Significant difference in p3sp, by p3edu1

-   Significant difference in p3smc by p3edu2

-   Significant difference in p3sp, p3smc, p3thpr by p3mar1

-   Significant difference in p3rbb, p3smc, p3atn by p3emp1

-   Effect sizes (\$\\eta\^2\$) are moderate-to-low (\$\<0.10\$)
